Asynchronous LORD++ (Zrnic, Ramdas & Jordan, JMLR 22(33), 2021: a credit earns from the first entry debited after its rejection is booked). What the register states: mFDR <= alpha when each null p-value is super-uniform conditional on the decisions booked before its debit (their Theorem 1). FDR <= alpha additionally needs independent null p-values (their Theorem 3) or Fisher positive local dependence (Biometrical Journal 66, 2024, Theorem 3).
